title: LOW LEVELS OF PFAS DETECTED IN FORT SHAFTER WATER SYSTEM ON OʻAHU
summary: HONOLULU — Low levels of PFAS (perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances) have been detected for the first time in water samples collected at Fort Shafter Wells Chlorinator.
